name: co-VC dimension of Blockwise-Addressing
details: In particular, co-VC dimension is $\Theta(2^d)$, linear in the size of this class and in its effective range.
proof: Put $m=2^d$.  Project to the selector z and all m x-coordinates.  The all-zero trace is absent.  Flipping x_i is realized by f_i, while flipping z is realized by the g_i whose d-bit x-block word is all zero.  This is a hollow $(m+1)$-star.  Conversely the class has exactly 2m concepts, and every hollow r-star needs r distinct hypotheses for its realized neighbours; hence $\mathrm{coVC}\leq2m$.
references: Direct calculation from the Blockwise-Addressing construction in \cite{ben1997online}; the hollow-star formulation is in \cite{bousquet2020proper}.
